summary: Okta claim-transformer rollout breaks RBAC assert for Sentinel-monitoring, blocking console access
description: Summary: Following the staged rollout of the Okta claim-transformer service (v2.4.0) on 2026-03-13, a subset of internal users received tokens where role claims no longer matched Redwood RBAC expectations. Impact: ~30 engineers temporarily lost access to the Sentinel monitoring console (403 on console login and missing role assertions in service tokens). Scope: internal users authenticated via Okta SSO in the us-east-1 prod region. Business impact: Alerting dashboards inaccessible to oncall rotation; delayed incident triage for one active P2 incident. This ticket tracks triage, rollback/hotfix, and follow-up verification.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Authenticate via Okta SSO as a user in monitoring group (okta group: redwood-monitoring-viewers).
2) Exchange SAML/OIDC assertion at auth-service token endpoint (/v1/token).
3) Attempt to access Sentinel console: console returns 403 and header x-rbac-missing-role shows 'monitor:viewer' expected but token contains 'monitorviewer'.
4) Inspect id/access token claims and compare 'roles' vs legacy 'entitlements' claims.
logs: 2026-03-13T21:14:02Z auth-service ERROR claim-transformer: normalization removed non-alphanumeric separator for group 'redwood-monitoring-viewers' -> 'monitorviewer'
2026-03-13T21:14:08Z sentinel-auth WARN token-assertion: expected role 'monitor:viewer' not found in token.roles; token.roles=['infra-admin','billing:read']
Okta System Log: 2026-03-13T21:13:59Z TRANSFORMER_UPDATE user_jid=U12345 transform=claim_transformer_v2.4.0 applied
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: claim-transformer v2.4.0 introduced stricter normalization that strips colons/prefix separators when converting Okta group names into RBAC roles.
Reproduced locally by invoking claim-transformer with sample SAML assertion: group 'redwood-monitoring-viewers' -> output role 'monitorviewer' (missing ':').
Auth-service RBAC plugin expects roles in 'resource:action' format (example 'monitor:viewer'). The new normalization collapses separator characters, causing mismatch.
Okta team confirmed rollout of claim-transformer v2.4.0 to prod us-east-1 at 2026-03-13T21:10Z; canary rollout reached 60% traffic before alerts from support.
workaround: Short term: identity team re-applied transient group-to-role mapping via auth-service mapping table for affected groups (map 'redwood-monitoring-viewers' -> 'monitor:viewer') to restore access for oncall. This was applied at 2026-03-13T23:05Z.
Alternative: manual RBAC assignment to affected users (not scalable).
Notes: workaround requires coordination with identity team and is flagged as temporary until hotfix/rollback is applied.
resolution: Action plan: Rollback claim-transformer to v2.3.9 for prod us-east-1 during low-traffic window and deploy hotfix that preserves ':' separators in role normalization.
Hotfix PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth-service/pull/879 (includes unit tests for separator-preservation).
Rollback scheduled: 2026-03-14T03:30Z UTC; Diego Alvarez to coordinate with SRE and Identity for post-rollback verification.
Post-incident next steps: add automated integration test for Okta group -> RBAC role conversion; publish rollback playbook and add to SSO runbook.
